**ai-brain-learning-memory v2.3.3 Changelog**

- Updated governance, copyright, and attribution to SynomosAI, with enhanced attestation and branding.
- Introduced/expanded multilingual support (zh-CN, en, ja, ko, es, fr, de, ar), with input detection and output rules.
- Integrated formal governance and provenance framework, referencing global standards (AI Passport Regime, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, OWASP, etc.).
- Updated and standardized metadata fields in SKILL.md/manifest (e.g., brand, ambassador, governance, fingerprint, aliases).
- Removed legacy and redundant documentation (e.g., ATTESTATION.md, skill-card.md).
- Added explicit disclaimers aligning with legal/compliance requirements.
- Improved clarity and documentation structure in skill files.
